headline: Public hearings on special permits for 51 Bacon Street, 719-723 Main Street, 995 Main Street, 20 Williams Street, and 96 Tower Road, plus a Police Station loan.
summary: Three hearings cover new apartments at 51 Bacon Street, 719-723 Main Street, and 20 Williams Street. Two more cover a drive-thru ATM at 995 Main Street and a fast-food restaurant at 96 Tower Road.
items: Public hearing on special permit at 51 Bacon Street for three residential units and a higher floor area ratio
